description: Runs a standard CMake configure step in a selected project directory.
name: cmake-standard-config
promptTemplate:
Run the complete Bash script with `shell_call` using its `command` parameter (example: `{ "command": "<complete Bash script>", "shell": "/bin/bash" }`). First check runtime availability with `shell_call` and `command -v node || true; command -v python3 || true`. Use `shell_call` for these native build and compiler commands. For a Node.js helper, use `nodejs_runtime` with `{ "inlineScript": "...", "workingDirectory": "...", "timeoutSeconds": 60 }`; for Python use `python_runtime` with `{ "inlineScript": "...", "workingDirectory": "...", "timeoutSeconds": 60 }`. Use `{{project_directory}}` as the CMake project directory.

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
PROJECT_DIR="{{project_directory}}"
[ -n "$PROJECT_DIR" ] && [ "$PROJECT_DIR" != "{{project_directory}}" ] || { echo "Missing project_directory" >&2; exit 1; }
cd "$PROJECT_DIR"
cmake -S . -B build
```

Return the CMake configure output.
systemInstruction: Run a standard CMake configure command in the selected project directory.
